queries_run: Navitas Semiconductor customer concentration risk 2026 distributor top customer

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：2025 年無單一經銷商占比揭露於 Distributor A 欄（*），Distributor B 占營收 46%、Distributor C 占 11%（2024 年 Distributor A 占 56%）；Distributor A 經銷協議於 2024 年底終止，2024 年認列 750 萬美元呆帳費用；2025 年底應收帳款 Distributor A1 44%（2024）、B 26%、C 18%、D 13%、E 12%（欄位對應依表格原文）。
findings.excerpt: Customer 2025 2024 Distributor A * 56 % Distributor B 46 % * Distributor C 11 % * At the end of 2024, the Company terminated its distribution agreement with Distributor A. As a result of this termination, the Company incurred a bad debt expense of $7.5 million included in Selling, general, and administrative expenses for the year ended December 31, 2024.

customer_concentration_credit.note: 客戶為經銷商而非終端客戶，未查到經銷商自身信用評等；2026 各季 10-Q 占比僅從搜尋摘要見到，未取得逐字原文，列為 clues。

clues.claim: 2026 Q3 10-Q：經銷商客戶集中度與應收帳款集中度（Distributor A 應收 33%、Distributor C 29%）
